shorts.title: What you will learn: More string tools
shorts.hook: Turn text into numbers, and numbers into text.
shorts.script: Turn text into numbers, and numbers into text. Today we edit text and we convert it. A string can become a number, and a number can become a string. A string has editing tools. Replace swaps a piece of text for another. Erase removes a piece. Insert adds a piece. Stoi turns text into an int. To string turns a number into text. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: More string tools.

shorts.title: More string tools in one minute
shorts.script: A string has editing tools. Replace swaps a piece of text for another. Erase removes a piece. Insert adds a piece. Stoi turns text into an int. To string turns a number into text. Think of a tailor. He cuts a piece, stitches a new piece, and measures the cloth. The text is Goa is sunny. Replace starts at index seven, cuts five letters, and puts in warm. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: More string tools in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The text holds the two characters four and two.
shorts.script: The text holds the two characters four and two. Stoi reads them as the number forty-two. Now we can do maths. Forty-two plus one is forty-three. To string turns eighty-four into text. Plus joins it to the label. The program prints forty-three, then Total colon eighty-four. Replace, erase and insert edit a string. The first number is the start, and the second is the length. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Stoi on text that is not a number
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in more string tools?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in more string tools? Bug of the Day. We call stoi on the text abc. The program stops. It says terminate called after throwing an instance of invalid argument. Stoi cannot read letters as a number. Wrap the call in try and catch, and print a friendly message. Stoi cannot read letters as a number, so it throws an exception. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Stoi on text that is not a number.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you add two numbers from text in more string tools?
shorts.script: Can you add two numbers from text in more string tools? I asked a string to become a number. It said, I need a moment to digit. Convert the texts twelve and thirty to ints with stoi. Print their sum as text with to string. Write your answer in the comments. Replace, erase and insert edit a string. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
